The Authentic Name of Rusálka

Scholarly reference for Rusálka

Scholarly Transliteration

Rusálka

No indigenous writing system is securely attested for individual slavic names. The form shown is a modern scholarly transliteration.

ASCII Constraint

RUSALKA

Stripped of its identity, the name was reduced to plain Latin letters. The original orthography — stress, length, breathing — was erased by systems that only understand A-Z.

Unicode Restoration

Rusálka

The Unicode restoration recovers what ASCII destroyed. This is philological accuracy — not decoration. The domain encodes to Punycode, but the browser displays the truth.

Punycode Encoding
rusálka.com → xn--ruslka-rta.com

The non-ASCII characters in Rusálka are encoded while the ASCII remains visible. To the DNS, it is Punycode. To humanity, it is Rusálka. PUNICODEX does not claim this domain is available; always verify status with a registrar.

Tier Classification

Why Rusálka is classified as Tier-1

The Slavic restoration Rusálka preserves at least one distinctive feature its ASCII form loses — a diacritic or a distinctive letter that marks the original phonology. This makes it a single-tier Tier-1 name.

Stress
Preserved
Acute or circumflex accent marks the pitch stress of the original.

—
